title: SPINACH FERREDOXIN
citationTitle: Structure of the mutant E92K of [2Fe-2S] ferredoxin I from Spinacia oleracea at 1.7 A resolution.
assembly: Biological assembly 1 from deposited mmCIF operators; first model and highest-occupancy atom conformer only.

orientation.method: Soluble protein, biological-assembly centroid; no membrane orientation required

warnings: Deposited spinach ferredoxin I is the E92K mutant; this is not an unmutated native sequence.

surface.method: Gaussian heavy-atom density, marching cubes, edge-collapse decimation
surface.format: PCMS v1: 32-byte header, int16 xyz (0.002 nm), int8 normals, uint8 linear RGB, uint16 triangle indices
